# Validation protocol template

!!! warning "Draft template — for editorial review"
    This is a proposed document structure, not an approved study protocol or clinical recommendation. It supplies no scientific procedures, performance thresholds or sample-size requirements. Completing it does not establish approval or clinical readiness.

## How to use this template

Copy this outline into a separate document for a selected validation study. Replace each `[TODO: ...]` with study-specific information and supporting references. If a section does not apply, record “Not applicable” and explain why. Retain unresolved items explicitly for review.

Use the [validation framework](../validation-framework/index.md) as the shared context. Reference operational SOPs for repeatable procedures rather than embedding their full instructions here. Record proposed work in this protocol; document results in the subsequent report.

The public repository is for documentation. Describe data sources and controlled-access arrangements without entering patient records or identifiers.
